import math, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/views-lines')
from refit3 import fit_to_control, drawn, poly_dist, un3, rr
from bspl3 import deboor_v
from bspl import default_knots, degree_of
from refit import orig
def refit(C, u0, u1, init_u, tol, cap, N=256, h=1e-6):
    us = sorted(set([u0 + (u1-u0)*k/N for k in range(N+1)] + list(init_u)))
    S = [C(u) for u in us]
    M = len(us) - 1
    a, b = C(u0), C(u0 + h*(u1-u0)); st = un3((b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]))
    a, b = C(u1 - h*(u1-u0)), C(u1); et = un3((b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]))
    chosen = sorted(set([0, M] + [us.index(u) for u in init_u]))
    picks = 0
    while picks < cap:
        Q = [[rr(S[i][0]), rr(S[i][1])] for i in chosen]
        P, kn = fit_to_control(Q, st, et)
        D = drawn(P, kn, 3)
        worst = None
        for k in range(M+1):
            if k in chosen: continue
            d = poly_dist(D, S[k])
            if worst is None or d > worst[0]: worst = (d, k)
        if worst is None or worst[0] <= tol: break
        chosen.append(worst[1]); chosen.sort(); picks += 1
    return [(rr(S[i][0]) + 0.0, rr(S[i][1]) + 0.0) for i in chosen]
tol = float(sys.argv[1])
cases = [[[0,0],[100,50],[200,0],[300,50]], [[0,0],[10,5],[20,0],[30,5]], [[0,0],[1000,100],[2000,0],[3000,100]], [[0,0],[1000,10],[2000,0],[3000,10]], [[0,0],[100,50],[200,0],[300,50],[400,0]], [[0,0],[1000,500],[2000,0],[3000,500],[4000,0]]]
for ctrl in cases:
    e = orig(['detail_line ' + json.dumps({"control": ctrl}), 'convert_spline {"id":100002}'])['100002']
    p = degree_of(len(ctrl), None); U = default_knots(len(ctrl), p)
    C = lambda u, ctrl=ctrl, U=U, p=p: deboor_v(ctrl, U, p, u, 'mix')
    inner = sorted(set(U[p+1:len(ctrl)]))
    fit = refit(C, U[p], U[len(ctrl)], inner, tol, 64)
    theirs = [tuple(q) for q in e['fit']]
    print(ctrl, 'orig', len(theirs), 'mine', len(fit), 'SAME' if fit == theirs else 'DIFF', 'common', len(set(fit) & set(theirs)))

"""Search arithmetic variants of the beam layout against the original on several beams.
Collect original paths once (cache), then score each variant combination."""
import json, math, sys, os, itertools, pickle
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rebar-agent')
import fit_beam3 as fb
def unit(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1]+v[2]*v[2]); return [v[0]/l, v[1]/l, v[2]/l]
def cross(a, b):
    return [a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1], a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2], a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]]
PARAMS = {"cover": 30, "bottom": {"count": 3, "diameter": 12.5}, "top": {"count": 2, "diameter": 6.3}}
CASES = [('gb_4.bimcraft', b) for b in range(100004, 100010)] + [('gb_3.bimcraft', b) for b in range(100004, 100010)] + [('gb_2.bimcraft', b) for b in range(100004, 100010)] + [('beams1.bimcraft', 100006), ('beams1.bimcraft', 100010)]
cache = '/tmp/rebar-agent/search_beam.cache'
data = pickle.load(open(cache, 'rb')) if os.path.exists(cache) else {}
for f, bid in CASES:
    if (f, bid) in data: continue
    j0 = json.load(open('/tmp/rebar-agent/' + f)); e = j0['elements'][str(bid)]
    if e['category'] != 'beam': continue
    elev = [v for v in j0['elements'].values() if v['guid'] == e['level']][0]['elevation']
    tname = [v['name'] for v in j0['library'].values() if v['guid'] == e['type']][0]; t = j0['types']['runs']['beam'][tname]
    p = dict(PARAMS); p['host'] = bid
    j = fb.run_orig('/tmp/rebar-agent/' + f, 'reinforce ' + json.dumps(p))
    bars = [v['path'] for v in j['elements'].values() if v['category'] == 'rebar']
    data[(f, bid)] = (e, elev, t, bars)
pickle.dump(data, open(cache, 'wb'))

def model(e, elev, t, V):
    w, h = t['width'], t['depth']
    s, en = e['start'], e['end']; off = e.get('offset', 0.0); eoff = e.get('end_offset', off); just = e.get('justify', 'top')
    dx = en[0]-s[0]; dy = en[1]-s[1]
    plan = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); rz = eoff-off; length = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+rz*rz)
    if V['half'] == 'a': half = h/2.0*(length/plan)
    elif V['half'] == 'b': half = h/2.0*length/plan
    elif V['half'] == 'c': half = h*length/plan/2.0
    else: half = h/(2.0*plan/length)
    if V['abs']:
        ch = lambda z: z - half if just == 'top' else (z if just == 'centre' else z + half)
        z0 = ch(elev+off); z1 = ch(elev+eoff)
        dz = z1 - z0
        oz = z0 - elev
    else:
        ch = lambda z: z - half if just == 'top' else (z if just == 'centre' else z + half)
        z0 = ch(off); z1 = ch(eoff)
        dz = z1 - z0; oz = z0
    if V['dz'] == 'rel': dz = eoff - off
    dv = [dx, dy, dz]
    L = math.sqrt(dv[0]**2+dv[1]**2+dv[2]**2)
    if V['L'] == 'line': L = length
    al = [dv[0]/L, dv[1]/L, dv[2]/L] if V['al'] == 'div' else unit(dv)
    ac = unit([-al[1], al[0], 0.0]) if V['ac'] == 'al' else [-dy/plan, dx/plan, 0.0]
    up = cross(al, ac)
    o = [s[0], s[1], oz]
    c = PARAMS['cover']; hh = h/2; hw = w/2
    def at(tt, a, u):
        if V['at'] == 'sum':
            return [o[i] + al[i]*tt + ac[i]*a + up[i]*u for i in range(3)]
        else:
            return [o[i] + (al[i]*tt + (ac[i]*a + up[i]*u)) for i in range(3)]
    out = []
    for name in ('bottom', 'top'):
        r = PARAMS[name]; d = r['diameter']; n = r['count']
        a = hw - c - d/2
        ats = [0.0] if n == 1 else [-a + (2*a)*i/(n-1) for i in range(n)]
        if V['u'] == 1:
            u = -(hh - c - d/2) if name == 'bottom' else hh - c - d/2
        else:
            u = -hh + c + d/2 if name == 'bottom' else hh - (c + d/2)
        for aa in ats:
            out.append([at(c, aa, u), at(L - c, aa, u)])
    return out
space = dict(half=['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], abs=[True, False], dz=['axis', 'rel'], L=['axis', 'line'], al=['div', 'unit'], ac=['al', 'dv'], at=['sum', 'nest'], u=[1, 2])
keys = list(space)
results = []
for combo in itertools.product(*[space[k] for k in keys]):
    V = dict(zip(keys, combo))
    ok = tot = 0
    for (f, bid), (e, elev, t, bars) in data.items():
        exp = model(e, elev, t, V)
        for b, ex in zip(bars, exp):
            for p1, p2 in zip(b, ex):
                for x, y in zip(p1, p2):
                    tot += 1; ok += (x == y)
    results.append((ok, tot, V))
results.sort(key=lambda r: -r[0])
for r in results[:10]:
    print(r[0], r[1], r[2])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Try csg.js variants on the inspection box (a cylinder less a smaller one) against the
original's output."""
import itertools, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/csg')
import csg

opts = list(itertools.product([True, False], [False, True], ['top_bottom', 'bottom_top', 'sides_first'], ['rev', 'rev0']))
orig_pts, orig_tris = csg.load_orig('/tmp/ifc-export-agent/csg/inspection.txt')
for pr, ur, co, br in opts:
    csg.OPT['plane_recompute'] = pr
    csg.OPT['unit_recip'] = ur
    a = csg.prism_polys(csg.circle(0, 0, 125), -300.0, 0.0, cap_order=co, bottom_rev=br)
    b = csg.prism_polys(csg.circle(0, 0, 105), -280.0, 0.0, cap_order=co, bottom_rev=br)
    res = csg.subtract(a, b)
    pts, tris = csg.triangulate(res)
    fp = [tuple(csg.fmt(c) for c in (p.x, p.y, p.z)) for p in pts]
    same_pts = sum(1 for x, y in zip(fp, orig_pts) if x == y)
    same_tris = sum(1 for x, y in zip(tris, orig_tris) if x == y)
    print(pr, ur, co, br, 'points', len(pts), 'vs', len(orig_pts), 'first-equal', same_pts, 'tris', len(tris), 'vs', len(orig_tris), 'equal', same_tris)
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        print(fp[:6])
        print(orig_pts[:6])

from bspl3 import deboor_v

p = 3; U = default_knots(4, 3)

import json, pickle, math
data = pickle.load(open('/tmp/rebar-agent/search_beam.cache', 'rb'))
def unit(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1]+v[2]*v[2]); return [v[0]/l, v[1]/l, v[2]/l]
def cross(a, b):
    return [a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1], a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2], a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]]
def ups(dx, dy, dz):
    L = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz); hz = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
    al = [dx/L, dy/L, dz/L]
    out = {}
    for an, a in (('div', al), ('unit', unit([dx, dy, dz]))):
        for cn, c in (('dv', [-dy/hz, dx/hz, 0.0]), ('al', unit([-a[1], a[0], 0.0])), ('alh', [-a[1]/math.hypot(a[0], a[1]), a[0]/math.hypot(a[0], a[1]), 0.0]),
                      ('alraw', [-a[1], a[0], 0.0])):
            out[(an, cn, 'cross')] = cross(a, c)
            out[(an, cn, 'ucross')] = unit(cross(a, c))
            out[(an, cn, 'crossrev')] = cross(c, a)
        # gram schmidt of z
        z = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        k = a[2]
        g = [z[0]-k*a[0], z[1]-k*a[1], z[2]-k*a[2]]
        out[(an, '-', 'gram')] = unit(g)
    return out
score = {}
for key, (e, elev, t, bars) in data.items():
    off = e.get('offset', 0.0); eoff = e.get('end_offset', off)
    if off != eoff: continue
    s, en = e['start'], e['end']; dx = en[0]-s[0]; dy = en[1]-s[1]
    h = t['depth']; w = t['width']; c = 30.0
    half = h/2.0
    just = e.get('justify', 'top')
    z0 = (elev + off - half) if just == 'top' else (elev + off if just == 'centre' else elev + off + half)
    o = z0 - elev
    rows = [('b', 12.5, 3), ('t', 6.3, 2)]
    for name, U in ups(dx, dy, z0 - z0).items():
        ok = tot = 0
        bi = 0
        for (rn, d, n) in rows:
            u = -(h/2 - c - d/2) if rn == 'b' else h/2 - c - d/2
            for i in range(n):
                for pt in bars[bi]:
                    tot += 1; ok += (o + 0.0 + 0.0 + U[2]*u) == pt[2] or (o + U[2]*u) == pt[2]
                bi += 1
        sc = score.setdefault(name, [0, 0]); sc[0] += ok; sc[1] += tot
for k, v in sorted(score.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][0]):
    print(v, k)

"""Build projects with the original (walls, rooms...) and read their rooms as load_points and
elements (at finish) see them."""
import subprocess, json, os, tempfile, shutil
ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = '/workspace/.claude/worktrees/agent-a798dce38c11c4bb6/target/release/bimcraft-cli'


def build(cmds, path):
    a = [ORIG, 'run']
    for c in cmds:
        a += ['--cmd', c]
    a += ['--save', path]
    p = subprocess.run(a, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise Exception(p.stderr)
    return p.stdout


def query(path, cmds, exe=ORIG):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rq')
    try:
        shutil.copy(path, d)
        a = [exe, 'run', os.path.basename(path)]
        for c in cmds:
            a += ['--cmd', c]
        p = subprocess.run(a, cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
        return p.stdout.strip().split('\n'), p.stderr.strip()
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(d)


def rooms_finish(path):
    out, err = query(path, ['room_area {"at": "finish"}', 'elements {"category": "room"}', 'load_points {}'])
    if err:
        return None, err
    el = json.loads(out[-2])
    lp = json.loads(out[-1])
    return el, lp

"""Show the first triangles of my csg.js result and the original's, as coordinates."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/csg')
import csg
from try_inspection2 import written

n = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 14
start = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0
csg.OPT['plane_recompute'] = True
csg.OPT['unit_recip'] = False
orig_pts, orig_tris = csg.load_orig('/tmp/ifc-export-agent/csg/inspection.txt')
a = [csg.Poly(t) for t in written(csg.circle(0, 0, 125), -300.0, 0.0)]
b = [csg.Poly(t) for t in written(csg.circle(0, 0, 105), -280.0, 0.0)]
res = csg.subtract(a, b)
pts, tris = csg.triangulate(res)
fp = [tuple(csg.fmt(c) for c in (p.x, p.y, p.z)) for p in pts]
for k in range(start, start + n):
    m = [fp[i] for i in tris[k]]
    o = [orig_pts[i] for i in orig_tris[k]]
    print(('   ' if m == o else '!! ') + 'mine', tris[k], m)
    print('   orig', orig_tris[k], o)

                pts.append(v)
            ids.append(index[k])

"""Helpers to run the original (and mine) on project files."""
import json, os, subprocess, tempfile, shutil, re

ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = '/workspace/.claude/worktrees/agent-a67e925de02b79509/target/release/bimcraft-cli'


def run(args, files=None, exe=ORIG, stdin=None, timeout=120):
    """Runs exe with args in a fresh dir holding files {name: bytes|str}; returns
    (code, stdout, stderr, {name: bytes} of files after)."""
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='la', dir='/tmp/loader-agent/tmp')
    try:
        for k, v in (files or {}).items():
            if isinstance(v, str):
                v = v.encode()
            p = os.path.join(d, k)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
            with open(p, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(v)
        p = subprocess.run([exe] + args, cwd=d, capture_output=True, input=stdin, timeout=timeout)
        out = {}
        for root, dirs, fs in os.walk(d):
            for f in fs:
                full = os.path.join(root, f)
                out[os.path.relpath(full, d)] = open(full, 'rb').read()
        return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace'), p.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace'), out
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(d)


os.makedirs('/tmp/loader-agent/tmp', exist_ok=True)


def dumps(doc):
    return json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def open_file(text, exe=None, save=True):
    exe = exe or os.environ.get("LA_EXE", ORIG)
    """Opens text as x.bimcraft; returns (code, open reply or error, saved doc text or None)."""
    if not isinstance(text, (str, bytes)):
        text = dumps(text)
    args = ['run', 'x.bimcraft'] + (['--save', 'y.bimcraft'] if save else [])
    code, out, err, fl = run(args, {'x.bimcraft': text}, exe=exe)
    saved = fl.get('y.bimcraft')
    lines = out.splitlines()
    reply = lines[0] if lines else ''
    if code != 0:
        return code, err.strip(), None
    return code, reply, saved.decode() if saved else None


def load(path):
    return json.load(open(path), object_pairs_hook=lambda kv: dict(kv))


GUID = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}')


def norm(s):
    s = re.sub(r'"uid": \d+', '"uid": <UID>', s)
    m = {}

    def rep(mo):
        g = mo.group(0)
        if g not in m:
            m[g] = 'GUID-%d' % (len(m) + 1)
        return m[g]
    return GUID.sub(rep, s)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""With the Colebrook settled (Swamee-Jain start, f iteration, |df| < 1e-14), search area/velocity/J/loss orders."""
import sys, json, math, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/hydro-agent')
data = json.load(open('/tmp/hydro-agent/wdata2.json')) + [d for d in json.load(open('/tmp/hydro-agent/wdata.json')) if len(d) == 6]
NU, EPS_MM, G = 1.004e-6, 0.0015, 9.81
from wfit3 import AREAS, VELS, RES, RELS, JS, LOSSES, r2

def colebrook(Re, rel):
    f = 0.25 / math.log10(rel / 3.7 + 5.74 / Re ** 0.9) ** 2
    for _ in range(100):
        s = -2 * math.log10(rel / 3.7 + 2.51 / (Re * math.sqrt(f)))
        fn = 1 / (s * s)
        d = abs(fn - f)
        f = fn
        if d < 1e-14:
            break
    return f

res = []
for (an, af), (vn, vf), (rn, rf), (ln, lf) in itertools.product(AREAS.items(), VELS.items(), RES.items(), RELS.items()):
    pre = []
    for dn, q, j5, v, lk, di in data:
        D = di / 1000
        A = af(D)
        V = vf(q, A)
        Re = rf(V, D)
        f = 64 / Re if Re < 2300 else colebrook(Re, lf(D, di))
        pre.append((f, V, D, lk))
    for (jn, jf), (lname, lfun) in itertools.product(JS.items(), LOSSES.items()):
        if jf is None:
            continue
        ok = sum(1 for f, V, D, lk in pre if r2(lfun(jf(f, V, D), 1e6)) == lk)
        res.append((ok, an, vn, rn, ln, jn, lname))
res.sort(key=lambda r: -r[0])
for r in res[:20]:
    print(r)
print('of', len(data))

        ok = sum(1 for f, V, D, lk in pre if r2(lfun(jf(f, V, D), 1e6)) == lk)
        res.append((ok, an, vn, rn, ln, jn, lname))
res.sort(key=lambda r: -r[0])
for r in res[:20]:
    print(r)
print('of', len(data))

def base(f, k=1.0):
    s1 = f.storey('L1', 0.0)

def wall(f, s, origin, xdir, foot, h, name='W', zbase=0.0):
    lp = f.lp(s.lp, (origin[0], origin[1], zbase), (0, 0, 1), (xdir[0], xdir[1], 0))
    reps = [f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb(foot), h)])]
    w = f.add('IFCWALL', gid(), None, name, None, None, lp, f.pds(*reps), None, E('STANDARD'))
    f.contain(s, w)
    return w

        wall(f, s1, (x, y), (1, 0), [(0, -100), (5000, -100), (5000, 100), (0, 100)], 3000)
        wall(f, s1, (x, y + 3000), (1, 0), [(0, -100), (5000, -100), (5000, 100), (0, 100)], 3000)

def all_kinds(X, Y):
    def fn(f):
        s1 = f.storey('L1', 0.0)
        s2 = f.storey('L2', 3000.0)
        f.close_storeys()
        # walls
        w1 = wall_rect(f, s1, X, Y, X + 6000, Y, 200, 3000, name='W1')
        wall_rect(f, s1, X + 6000, Y, X + 6000, Y + 4000, 200, 3000, name='W2')
        # a floor with a hole, and an opening through it
        prof = f.arb([(X, Y), (X + 6000, Y), (X + 6000, Y + 4000), (X, Y + 4000)], [[(X + 1000, Y + 1000), (X + 2000, Y + 1000), (X + 2000, Y + 2000), (X + 1000, Y + 2000)]])
        sl = f.add('IFCSLAB', gid(), None, 'Floor', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 0, -200)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(prof, 200)])), None, E('FLOOR'))
        f.contain(s1, sl)
        op = f.add('IFCOPENINGELEMENT', gid(), None, 'Shaft', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 0, -200)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(X + 4000, Y + 1000), (X + 5000, Y + 1000), (X + 5000, Y + 2000), (X + 4000, Y + 2000)]), 200)])), None, E('OPENING'))
        f.add('IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT', gid(), None, None, None, sl, op)
        # a ceiling with a hole
        cprof = f.arb([(X, Y), (X + 6000, Y), (X + 6000, Y + 4000), (X, Y + 4000)], [[(X + 3000, Y + 1000), (X + 3500, Y + 1000), (X + 3500, Y + 1500), (X + 3000, Y + 1500)]])
        ce = f.add('IFCCOVERING', gid(), None, 'Ceiling', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 0, 2600)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(cprof, 20)])), None, E('CEILING'))
        f.contain(s1, ce)
        # a flat roof
        rf = f.add('IFCROOF', gid(), None, 'Roof', None, None, f.lp(s2.lp), None, None, E('FLAT_ROOF'))
        f.contain(s2, rf)
        rs = f.add('IFCSLAB', gid(), None, 'Roof slab', None, None, f.lp(s2.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(X, Y), (X + 6000, Y), (X + 6000, Y + 4000), (X, Y + 4000)]), 300)])), None, E('ROOF'))
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, rf, (rs,))
        # a mass
        ms = f.add('IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY', gid(), None, 'Mass', None, 'Mass', f.lp(s1.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(X + 10000, Y), (X + 12000, Y), (X + 12000, Y + 2000), (X + 10000, Y + 2000)]), 3000)])), None, E('USERDEFINED'))
        f.contain(s1, ms)
        # a component
        fu = f.add('IFCFURNITURE', gid(), None, 'Table:T', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 3000, Y + 3000, 0)), f.pds(f.shape([f.mesh_box(-400, -400, 0, 400, 400, 750)], 'Tessellation')), None, E('NOTDEFINED'))
        f.contain(s1, fu)
        # a beam and a column
        bm = f.add('IFCBEAM', gid(), None, 'B', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X, Y + 6000, 2700)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(200, 300), 5000, pos=f.ax3((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0)))])), None, E('BEAM'))
        f.contain(s1, bm)
        co = f.add('IFCCOLUMN', gid(), None, 'C', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 8000, Y + 6000, 0)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(300, 300), 3000)])), None, E('COLUMN'))
        f.contain(s1, co)
        # a room
        sp = f.add('IFCSPACE', gid(), None, '1', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(X, Y), (X + 6000, Y), (X + 6000, Y + 4000), (X, Y + 4000)]), 2600)])), 'Office', E('ELEMENT'), E('SPACE'), None)
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, s1, (sp,))
        # a railing along an axis
        ax = f.shape([f.poly3([(0, 0, 1000), (3000, 0, 1000), (3000, 2000, 1000)])], 'Curve3D', 'Axis')
        bd = f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(50, 50, (0, 0)), 1000)])
        ra = f.add('IFCRAILING', gid(), None, 'R', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 14000, Y, 0)), f.pds(ax, bd), None, E('GUARDRAIL'))
        f.contain(s1, ra)
        # a stair
        st = f.add('IFCSTAIR', gid(), None, 'Stair', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 16000, Y, 0)), None, None, E('STRAIGHT_RUN_STAIR'))
        f.contain(s1, st)
        items = [f.extrude(f.rect(280, 900, (140 + i * 280, 0)), 175 * (i + 1)) for i in range(3)]
        fl = f.add('IFCSTAIRFLIGHT', gid(), None, 'Flight', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 16000, Y, 0)), f.pds(f.shape(items)), None, 4, 3, 175.0, 280.0, E('STRAIGHT'))
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, st, (fl,))
        # rebar in the beam
        rb = f.add('IFCREINFORCINGBAR', gid(), None, 'Bar', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X, Y + 6000, 2700)), f.pds(f.shape([f.add('IFCSWEPTDISKSOLID', f.poly3([(50, 0, -100), (4950, 0, -100)]), 8.0, None, None, None)], 'AdvancedSweptSolid')), None, 'CA-50', 16.0, None, None, E('MAIN'), None)
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, bm, (rb,))
        # a grid
        a1 = f.add('IFCGRIDAXIS', 'A', f.poly2([(X, Y - 1000), (X, Y + 5000)], close=False), True)
        a2 = f.add('IFCGRIDAXIS', '1', f.poly2([(X - 1000, Y), (X + 7000, Y)], close=False), True)
        g = f.add('IFCGRID', gid(), None, 'Grid', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp), None, (a1,), (a2,), None, E('RECTANGULAR'))
        f.contain(s1, g)
        # a door in W1
        olp = f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 1000, Y, 0))
        o = f.add('IFCOPENINGELEMENT', gid(), None, 'O', None, None, olp, f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(900, 400, (450, 0)), 2100)])), None, E('OPENING'))
        f.add('IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT', gid(), None, None, None, w1, o)
        d = f.add('IFCDOOR', gid(), None, 'D', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 1000, Y, 0)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(900, 50, (450, 0)), 2100)])), None, 2100.0, 900.0, E('DOOR'), E('SINGLE_SWING_LEFT'), None)
        f.add('IFCRELFILLSELEMENT', gid(), None, None, None, o, d)
        f.contain(s1, d)
        # a room separation line
        vs = f.add('IFCVIRTUALELEMENT', gid(), None, 'Sep', None, 'RoomSeparation', f.lp(s1.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.poly3([(X + 3000, Y), (X + 3000, Y + 4000)])], 'Curve3D', 'Axis')), None)
        f.contain(s1, vs)
        # a pipe and a sloped floor
        pp = f.add('IFCPIPESEGMENT', gid(), None, 'P', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X, Y + 8000, 500)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.add('IFCCIRCLEPROFILEDEF', E('AREA'), None, f.ax2(), 50.0), 3000, pos=f.ax3((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0)))])), None, E('RIGIDSEGMENT'))
        f.contain(s1, pp)
        sp_ = [(X + 20000, Y, 0), (X + 24000, Y, 400), (X + 24000, Y + 3000, 400), (X + 20000, Y + 3000, 0), (X + 20000, Y, -200), (X + 24000, Y, 200), (X + 24000, Y + 3000, 200), (X + 20000, Y + 3000, -200)]
        faces = [(0, 1, 2, 3), (4, 7, 6, 5), (0, 4, 5, 1), (1, 5, 6, 2), (2, 6, 7, 3), (3, 7, 4, 0)]
        sf = f.add('IFCSLAB', gid(), None, 'Sloped', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.brep(sp_, faces)], 'Brep')), None, E('FLOOR'))
        f.contain(s1, sf)
    return fn

import pickle, sys, math
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rebar-agent')
import beam_lib as B
data = pickle.load(open('/tmp/rebar-agent/search_beam.cache', 'rb'))
def variants(F, e, elev, c):
    # how the far end of a bar may be found
    o = F['o']; al = F['al']; L = F['L']
    z1 = None
    yield 'L-c', lambda a, u: B.at(F, L - c, a, u)
    yield 'L+(-c)', lambda a, u: B.at(F, L + (-c), a, u)
    end = [e['end'][0], e['end'][1], o[2] + (L * al[2])]
    F2 = dict(F); F2['o'] = [o[0] + al[0]*L, o[1] + al[1]*L, o[2] + al[2]*L]
    yield 'o+alL then -c', lambda a, u: B.at(F2, -c, a, u)
    F3 = dict(F); dv = [e['end'][0]-e['start'][0], e['end'][1]-e['start'][1], None]
    # absolute end of axis relative
    half = F['half']; just = e.get('justify', 'top'); off = e.get('offset', 0.0); eoff = e.get('end_offset', off)
    ch = lambda z: z - half if just == 'top' else (z if just == 'centre' else z + half)
    z0 = ch(elev+off); z1 = ch(elev+eoff)
    F3['o'] = [e['end'][0], e['end'][1], z1 - elev]
    yield 'axis end -c', lambda a, u: B.at(F3, -c, a, u)
    F4 = dict(F); F4['o'] = [o[0] + (e['end'][0]-e['start'][0]), o[1] + (e['end'][1]-e['start'][1]), o[2] + (z1 - z0)]
    yield 'o+dv -c', lambda a, u: B.at(F4, -c, a, u)
scores = {}
for key, (e, elev, t, bars) in data.items():
    F = B.frame(e, elev, t, {'half': 'a'})
    c = 30.0; hh = F['h']/2; hw = F['w']/2
    for vn, endf in variants(F, e, elev, c):
        exp = []
        for name, d, n in (('b', 12.5, 3), ('t', 6.3, 2)):
            a = hw - c - d/2
            ats = [-a + (2*a)*i/(n-1) for i in range(n)]
            u = -(hh - c - d/2) if name == 'b' else hh - c - d/2
            for aa in ats:
                exp.append([B.at(F, c, aa, u), endf(aa, u)])
        ok = tot = 0
        for b, ex in zip(bars, exp):
            for p1, p2 in zip(b, ex):
                for x, y in zip(p1, p2):
                    tot += 1; ok += x == y
        sc = scores.setdefault(vn, [0, 0]); sc[0] += ok; sc[1] += tot
print(scores)

    f = F(schema, units)
    f.header()
    fn(f)
    out.append(f.save(os.path.join(D, name + '.ifc')))


def walls_at(X, Y, extra=None):
    def fn(f):
        s1 = f.storey('L1', 0.0)
        s2 = f.storey('L2', 3000.0)
        f.close_storeys()
        wall_rect(f, s1, X, Y, X + 6000, Y, 200, 3000, name='W1')
        wall_rect(f, s1, X + 6000, Y, X + 6000, Y + 4000, 200, 3000, name='W2')
        if extra:
            extra(f, s1, s2, X, Y)
    return fn


def grid(f, s1, s2, X, Y):
    a1 = f.add('IFCGRIDAXIS', 'A', f.poly2([(X, Y - 1000), (X, Y + 5000)], close=False), True)
    a2 = f.add('IFCGRIDAXIS', '1', f.poly2([(X - 1000, Y), (X + 7000, Y)], close=False), True)
    g = f.add('IFCGRID', gid(), None, 'Grid', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp), None, (a1,), (a2,), None, E('RECTANGULAR'))
    f.contain(s1, g)


def comp(f, s1, s2, X, Y):
    fu = f.add('IFCFURNITURE', gid(), None, 'Table:T', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (X + 3000, Y + 3000, 0)), f.pds(f.shape([f.mesh_box(-400, -400, 0, 400, 400, 750)], 'Tessellation')), None, E('NOTDEFINED'))
    f.contain(s1, fu)


def room(f, s1, s2, X, Y):
    sp = f.add('IFCSPACE', gid(), None, '1', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(X, Y), (X + 6000, Y), (X + 6000, Y + 4000), (X, Y + 4000)]), 2600)])), 'Office', E('ELEMENT'), E('SPACE'), None)
    f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, s1, (sp,))

def mass(f, s1, s2, X, Y):
    ms = f.add('IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY', gid(), None, 'Mass', None, 'Mass', f.lp(s1.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(X + 10000, Y), (X + 12000, Y), (X + 12000, Y + 2000), (X + 10000, Y + 2000)]), 3000)])), None, E('USERDEFINED'))

def mk(name, extra):
    f = F('IFC4', 'mm')
    f.header()
    s1 = f.storey('L1', 0.0)
    s2 = f.storey('L2', 3000.0)
    f.close_storeys()
    w1 = wall_rect(f, s1, X, Y, X + 6000, Y, 200, 3000, name='W1')
    wall_rect(f, s1, X + 6000, Y, X + 6000, Y + 4000, 200, 3000, name='W2')
    extra(f, s1, s2, w1)
    out.append(f.save(os.path.join(D, name + '.ifc')))


def floor_hole(f, s1, s2, w1):
    prof = f.arb([(X, Y), (X + 6000, Y), (X + 6000, Y + 4000), (X, Y + 4000)], [[(X + 1000, Y + 1000), (X + 2000, Y + 1000), (X + 2000, Y + 2000), (X + 1000, Y + 2000)]])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare a triangulated face set (by its point list entity number) in two IFC files: the
first differing triangle, as coordinates."""
import re, sys
def load(path, ent):
    s = open(path).read()
    m = re.search(r'^#%d=IFCCARTESIANPOINTLIST3D\(\((.*)\)\);$' % ent, s, re.M)
    pts = re.findall(r'\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', m.group(1))
    m2 = re.search(r'^#\d+=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET\(#%d,\$,\.T\.,\((.*)\),\$\);$' % ent, s, re.M)
    tris = [tuple(int(x) - 1 for x in t) for t in re.findall(r'\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+)\)', m2.group(1))]
    return pts, tris
a = load(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[3]))
b = load(sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]))
print('points', len(a[0]), len(b[0]), 'tris', len(a[1]), len(b[1]))
for k, (ta, tb) in enumerate(zip(a[1], b[1])):
    ca = [a[0][i] for i in ta]
    cb = [b[0][i] for i in tb]
    if ca != cb:
        print('first differing triangle', k)
        for j in range(max(0, k - 3), min(k + 6, len(a[1]), len(b[1]))):
            print('  A', j, [a[0][i] for i in a[1][j]])
            print('  B', j, [b[0][i] for i in b[1][j]])
        break
else:
    print('same triangles (as coordinates)')

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/ifc-import-agent')
from ifcgen import *
import os

D = '/tmp/ifc-import-agent/components/c26'
os.makedirs(D, exist_ok=True)
out = []
X, Y = 250000000, 150000000


def mk(name, extra):
    f = F('IFC4', 'mm')
    f.header()
    s1 = f.storey('L1', 0.0)
    s2 = f.storey('L2', 3000.0)
    f.close_storeys()
    wall_rect(f, s1, X, Y, X + 6000, Y, 200, 3000, name='W1')
    extra(f, s1, s2)
    out.append(f.save(os.path.join(D, name + '.ifc')))


def unsupported(f, s1, s2):
    lp = f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 0, 0))
    e = f.add('IFCAIRTERMINAL', gid(), None, 'AT', None, None, lp, f.pds(f.shape([f.mesh_box(0, 0, 0, 100, 100, 100)], 'Tessellation')), None, E('NOTDEFINED'))
    f.contain(s1, e)


def skipped(f, s1, s2):
    lp = f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 0, 0))
    e = f.add('IFCWALL', gid(), None, 'NoBody', None, None, lp, None, None, E('STANDARD'))
    f.contain(s1, e)


def far_y_only(f, s1, s2):  # another wall near in x, far in y
    wall_rect(f, s1, 1000, Y, 7000, Y, 200, 3000, name='W2')


def room_near(f, s1, s2):  # a room whose placement is near but its body far
    sp = f.add('IFCSPACE', gid(), None, '1', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(X, Y - 3000), (X + 6000, Y - 3000), (X + 6000, Y - 100), (X, Y - 100)]), 2600)])), 'Office', E('ELEMENT'), E('SPACE'), None)
    f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, s1, (sp,))


def opening_near(f, s1, s2):  # an opening placed at the origin (its body far), voiding the wall, filled by a door far
    pass


def neg(f, s1, s2):  # a second wall at -X
    wall_rect(f, s1, -X, Y, -X + 6000, Y, 200, 3000, name='W2')


mk('unsupported', unsupported)
mk('skipped', skipped)
mk('far_y_only', far_y_only)
mk('room_near', room_near)
mk('neg', neg)
print(' '.join(out))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A Python model of water_size's arithmetic (to compare variants of the downstream formulas)."""
import math
NU, EPS_MM, G = 1.004e-6, 0.0015, 9.81
INSIDE = {20: 17.0, 25: 21.6, 32: 27.8, 40: 35.2, 50: 44.0, 60: 53.4, 75: 66.6, 85: 75.6, 110: 97.8}
DNS = [20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 60, 75, 85, 110]
FIT_ORDER = ['elbow90', 'elbow45', 'tee_through', 'tee_side', 'gate', 'globe', 'check']
EQ = {
    20: [1.1, 0.4, 0.7, 2.3, 0.1, 11.1, 2.5],
    25: [1.2, 0.5, 0.8, 2.4, 0.2, 11.4, 2.7],
    32: [1.5, 0.7, 0.9, 3.1, 0.3, 15.0, 3.8],
    40: [2.0, 1.0, 1.5, 4.6, 0.4, 22.0, 4.9],
    50: [3.2, 1.3, 2.2, 7.3, 0.7, 35.8, 6.8],
    60: [3.4, 1.5, 2.3, 7.6, 0.8, 37.9, 7.1],
    75: [3.7, 1.7, 2.4, 7.8, 0.9, 38.0, 8.2],
    85: [3.9, 1.8, 2.5, 8.0, 0.9, 40.0, 9.3],
    110: [4.3, 1.9, 2.6, 8.3, 1.0, 42.3, 10.4],
}

def rround(x, n):
    k = 10.0 ** n
    y = x * k
    r = math.floor(abs(y) + 0.5)
    # exact half-away-from-zero emulation of f64::round
    a = abs(y)
    fl = math.floor(a)
    r = fl + 1 if a - fl >= 0.5 else fl
    return math.copysign(r, y) / k

def colebrook(Re, rel):
    f = 0.25 / math.log10(rel / 3.7 + 5.74 / Re ** 0.9) ** 2
    for _ in range(100):
        s = -2 * math.log10(rel / 3.7 + 2.51 / (Re * math.sqrt(f)))
        fn = 1 / (s * s)
        d = abs(fn - f)
        f = fn
        if d < 1e-14:
            break
    return f

def hydraulics(q_lps, dn):
    di = INSIDE[dn]
    D = di / 1000
    A = math.pi / 4 * D * D
    V = q_lps / 1000 / A
    Re = V * D / NU
    f = 64 / Re if Re < 2300 else colebrook(Re, EPS_MM / di)
    J = f / D * V * V / (2 * G)
    return V, J

import sys, json, math, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/hydro-agent')
from wmodel import *
rows = json.load(open('/tmp/hydro-agent/wdown.json'))
SORTED = sorted(FIT_ORDER)

def leq_variants(p, dn):
    L = p.get('length', 0) or 0
    fits = p.get('fittings', {}) or {}
    e = dict(zip(FIT_ORDER, EQ[dn]))
    out = {}
    # fittings sum in canonical order
    fc = 0.0
    for k in FIT_ORDER:
        if k in fits:
            fc += fits[k] * e[k]
    fs = 0.0
    for k in SORTED:
        if k in fits:
            fs += fits[k] * e[k]
    fg = 0.0
    for k in fits:  # given (sorted json -> sorted)
        fg += fits[k] * e[k]
    out['L/1000+canon'] = L / 1000 + fc
    out['L/1000+sorted'] = L / 1000 + fs
    out['canon+L/1000'] = fc + L / 1000
    out['sorted+L/1000'] = fs + L / 1000
    # accumulate starting from L/1000
    acc = L / 1000
    for k in SORTED:
        if k in fits:
            acc += fits[k] * e[k]
    out['acc sorted from L'] = acc
    acc = L / 1000
    for k in FIT_ORDER:
        if k in fits:
            acc += fits[k] * e[k]
    out['acc canon from L'] = acc
    acc = 0.0
    for k in SORTED:
        if k in fits:
            acc += fits[k] * e[k]
    out['acc sorted then L'] = acc + L / 1000
    # in mm
    acc = L
    for k in SORTED:
        if k in fits:
            acc += fits[k] * e[k] * 1000
    out['mm acc sorted'] = acc / 1000
    return out

score = {}
for p, o in rows:
    dn = p['dn']
    V, J = hydraulics(p['flow'], dn)
    for name, leq in leq_variants(p, dn).items():
        for lname, loss in [('J*Leq*9.81', J * leq * 9.81), ('J*Leq*G', J * leq * G)]:
            okl = rround(leq, 2) == o['equivalent_length_m']
            okloss = rround(loss, 2) == o['loss_kpa']
            key = (name, lname)
            s = score.setdefault(key, [0, 0, 0])
            s[0] += okl
            s[1] += okloss
            s[2] += 1
for k, v in sorted(score.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][1]):
    print(k, v)

# end pressure variants with the best loss
print('--- end')
ends = {}
for p, o in rows:
    if 'pressure' not in p:
        continue
    dn = p['dn']
    V, J = hydraulics(p['flow'], dn)
    leq = leq_variants(p, dn)['acc sorted from L']
    loss = J * leq * 9.81
    P = p['pressure']
    rise = p.get('rise', 0) or 0
    cands = {
        'P-loss-rise/1000*9.81': P - loss - rise / 1000 * 9.81,
        'P-loss-rise*9.81/1000': P - loss - rise * 9.81 / 1000,
        'P-(loss+rise/1000*9.81)': P - (loss + rise / 1000 * 9.81),
        'P-rise/1000*9.81-loss': P - rise / 1000 * 9.81 - loss,
        'P-loss-9.81*rise/1000': P - loss - 9.81 * rise / 1000,
        'P-loss-rise*0.00981': P - loss - rise * 0.00981,
        'P-r2(loss)-rise/1000*9.81': P - rround(loss, 2) - rise / 1000 * 9.81,
        'P-loss-9.81*(rise/1000)': P - loss - 9.81 * (rise / 1000),
        'P-(loss+rise*9.81/1000)': P - (loss + rise * 9.81 / 1000),
        '(P-loss)-rise/1000*9.81': (P - loss) - rise / 1000 * 9.81,
        'P - (J*leq + rise/1000)*9.81': P - (J * leq + rise / 1000) * 9.81,
    }
    for k, v in cands.items():
        s = ends.setdefault(k, [0, 0])
        s[0] += rround(v, 2) == o['end_kpa']
        s[1] += 1
for k, v in sorted(ends.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][0]):
    print(k, v)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Find nice inputs where end-pressure formula variants round differently, and ask the original."""
import sys, json, math, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/hydro-agent')
from lib import *
from wmodel import *

def leq_of(p):
    dn = p['dn']
    e = dict(zip(FIT_ORDER, EQ[dn]))
    acc = (p.get('length', 0) or 0) / 1000
    for k in sorted(p.get('fittings', {})):
        acc += p['fittings'][k] * e[k]
    return acc

def cands(p):
    V, J = hydraulics(p['flow'], p['dn'])
    loss = J * leq_of(p) * 9.81
    P = p['pressure']
    rise = p.get('rise', 0)
    return {
        'a': P - loss - rise / 1000 * 9.81,
        'b': P - loss - rise * 9.81 / 1000,
        'c': P - (loss + rise / 1000 * 9.81),
        'd': P - rise / 1000 * 9.81 - loss,
        'e': P - loss - rise * 0.00981,
        'f': P - (J * leq_of(p) + rise / 1000) * 9.81,
        'g': P - loss - 9.81 * rise / 1000,
    }

r = random.Random(3)
found = []
tries = 0
while len(found) < 400 and tries < 2000000:
    tries += 1
    p = {'flow': r.choice([0.001, 0.0001, 1e-5]), 'dn': 110, 'length': 0,
         'pressure': r.randint(0, 2000) / 10 if r.random() < 0.5 else r.randint(0, 200),
         'rise': r.randint(-3000, 3000) * 10 if r.random() < 0.5 else r.randint(-30000, 30000)}
    c = cands(p)
    vals = {k: rround(v, 2) for k, v in c.items()}
    if len(set(vals.values())) > 1:
        found.append((p, vals))
print('found', len(found), 'in', tries)
items = [('water_size', p) for p, _ in found]
res = orig(items)
score = {}
for (p, vals), rr in zip(found, res):
    o = json.loads(canon(*rr)[3:])
    for k, v in vals.items():
        score[k] = score.get(k, 0) + (v == o['end_kpa'])
print(score)

]
for val in cases:
    for exe in (ORIG, MINE):
        e = copy.deepcopy(d)
        e['elements'][eid].setdefault('graphics', {})['layers'] = val
        code, msg, s = open_file(e, exe=exe, save=True)

            sd = json.loads(s)

import sys, json, math
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/elec-agent')
from rooms_lib import *
R, sweep = 3000, 45
a = math.radians(sweep)
e = [round(R * math.cos(a), 6), round(R * math.sin(a), 6)]
cmds = ['wall {"points": [[0,0],[%s,0]], "type": "Interior - 100mm"}' % R,
        'wall {"points": [[%s,0],[%s,%s]], "arc": %s, "type": "Interior - 100mm"}' % (R, e[0], e[1], sweep),
        'wall {"points": [[%s,%s],[0,0]], "type": "Interior - 100mm"}' % (e[0], e[1]),
        'room {"point": [%s, %s], "name": "A", "frozen": true}' % (R * 0.5 * math.cos(a / 2), R * 0.5 * math.sin(a / 2))]
path = '/tmp/elec-agent/rt_wedge.bimcraft'
print(build(cmds, path))
d = json.load(open(path))
for k, v in d['elements'].items():
    if v['category'] == 'room':
        kept = v['kept']
        for which in ('centre', 'finish'):
            o = kept[which]['outer']
            print(which, len(o), 'holes', len(kept[which]['holes']))
            for p in o:
                print('   ', p)

"""Which parts get a fresh GUID: one another part, an element or a library entry has?"""
import sys, json, copy
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/loader-agent')
from lib import *
d = load('/tmp/loader-agent/corpus/c8.bimcraft')
E = d['elements']
level = next(k for k, e in E.items() if e['category'] == 'level')
LG = E[level]['guid']
floor = next(k for k, e in E.items() if e['category'] == 'floor' and e.get('sketch'))
FG = E[floor]['guid']
LIBG = next(iter(d['library'].values()))['guid'] if isinstance(next(iter(d['library'].values())), dict) else None
lib_items = list(d['library'].items())[:3]
print('library sample', lib_items)


def run_case(label, mut, probe):
    res = []
    for exe in (ORIG, MINE):
        e = copy.deepcopy(d)
        mut(e)
        code, msg, s = open_file(e, exe=exe, save=True)
        if code:
            res.append('ERR ' + msg[:200])
        else:
            res.append(probe(json.loads(s)))
    print('%s %-50s O=%s M=%s' % ('same' if res[0] == res[1] else 'DIFF', label, res[0], res[1]))


def sym_guid(g):
    def m(e):
        e['families']['Box']['symbols'][1]['guid'] = g
    return m


def probe_sym(g):
    return lambda s: 'kept' if s['families']['Box']['symbols'][1]['guid'] == g else 'fresh'


lib0 = d['library'][next(iter(d['library']))]
LIBGUID = lib0['guid'] if isinstance(lib0, dict) else None
run_case('symbol guid = level guid', sym_guid(LG), probe_sym(LG))
run_case('symbol guid = library guid', sym_guid(LIBGUID), probe_sym(LIBGUID))
FORMG = d['families']['Box']['forms'][0]['guid']
run_case('symbol guid = form guid (same family, earlier)', sym_guid(FORMG), probe_sym(FORMG))
LAYERG = d['types']['wall']['Exterior - 300mm']['layers'][0]['guid']
run_case('symbol guid = wall layer guid', sym_guid(LAYERG), probe_sym(LAYERG))
SKG = E[floor]['sketch'][0]['guid']
run_case('symbol guid = floor sketch line guid (later)', sym_guid(SKG), probe_sym(SKG))
run_case('symbol guid = uppercase form guid', sym_guid(FORMG.upper()), lambda s: 'kept' if s['families']['Box']['symbols'][1]['guid'] == FORMG else 'fresh:' + s['families']['Box']['symbols'][1]['guid'][:8])
run_case('symbol guid = braced form guid', sym_guid('{' + FORMG + '}'), lambda s: 'kept' if s['families']['Box']['symbols'][1]['guid'] == FORMG else 'fresh:' + s['families']['Box']['symbols'][1]['guid'][:8])
run_case('symbol guid = sym0 guid', sym_guid(d['families']['Box']['symbols'][0]['guid']), probe_sym(d['families']['Box']['symbols'][0]['guid']))


def sk_guid(g):
    def m(e):
        e['elements'][floor]['sketch'][1]['guid'] = g
    return m


def probe_sk(g):
    return lambda s: 'kept' if s['elements'][floor]['sketch'][1]['guid'] == g else 'fresh'


run_case('sketch guid = own floor guid', sk_guid(FG), probe_sk(FG))
run_case('sketch guid = level guid', sk_guid(LG), probe_sk(LG))
run_case('sketch guid = sketch0 guid', sk_guid(E[floor]['sketch'][0]['guid']), probe_sk(E[floor]['sketch'][0]['guid']))
run_case('sketch guid = form guid (earlier)', sk_guid(FORMG), probe_sk(FORMG))
run_case('sketch guid = library guid', sk_guid(LIBGUID), probe_sk(LIBGUID))
# which of two keeps: layer later in visit order equal to a symbol? layers are visited first
def lay(e):
    e['types']['wall']['Exterior - 300mm']['layers'][1]['guid'] = SKG
run_case('layer guid = floor sketch guid (layer first)', lay,
         lambda s: ('layer kept' if s['types']['wall']['Exterior - 300mm']['layers'][1]['guid'] == SKG else 'layer fresh') + '/' +
         ('sketch kept' if s['elements'][floor]['sketch'][0]['guid'] == SKG else 'sketch fresh'))
# element guid equal to a part guid: does the element keep it?
def elg(e):
    e['elements'][level]['guid'] = FORMG
run_case('level guid = form guid', elg, lambda s: ('level kept' if s['elements'][level]['guid'] == FORMG else 'level fresh') + '/' +
         ('form kept' if s['families']['Box']['forms'][0]['guid'] == FORMG else 'form fresh'))
# library entry guid equal to a part guid
def libg(e):
    k = next(iter(e['library']))
    e['library'][k]['guid'] = FORMG
run_case('library guid = form guid', libg, lambda s: ('lib kept' if any(v['guid'] == FORMG for v in s['library'].values()) else 'lib fresh') + '/' +
         ('form kept' if s['families']['Box']['forms'][0]['guid'] == FORMG else 'form fresh'))

"""mkfx.py spec.json: {name: [commands]} -> /tmp/edit-agent/fx/gen/<name>.bimcraft made by the original."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, shutil
spec = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
out = '/tmp/edit-agent/fx/gen'

for name, cmds in spec.items():

    for f in ['/tmp/edit-agent/fx/c.xyz', '/tmp/edit-agent/fx/d.dxf', '/tmp/edit-agent/fx/all.bimcraft']:

    else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""gen_xf.py out.txt [fixtures...]: cases moving/copying/rotating/mirroring each element of fixtures."""
import json, sys, random
random.seed(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[2].isdigit() else 1)
out = open(sys.argv[1], 'w')
fx = [a for a in sys.argv[2:] if not a.isdigit()] or ['/tmp/edit-agent/fx/all.bimcraft', '/tmp/edit-agent/fx/more.bimcraft', '/tmp/edit-agent/fx/house.bimcraft'] + ['/tmp/edit-agent/fx/gen/%s.bimcraft' % n for n in ['box', 'chain', 'node3', 'tee', 'arcs', 'levels', 'diag', 'loc']]
ops = [
    'move {"ids": %s, "by": [100, 50]}',
    'move {"ids": %s, "by": [0, -700]}',
    'copy {"ids": %s, "by": [12000, 0]}',
    'rotate {"ids": %s, "about": [1000, 2000], "angle": 30}',
    'rotate {"ids": %s, "about": [0, 0], "angle": 90}',
    'rotate {"ids": %s, "about": [500, 500], "angle": -45, "copy": true}',
    'mirror {"ids": %s, "axis": [[1000, 2000], [3000, 3000]]}',
    'mirror {"ids": %s, "axis": [[0, 1000], [1000, 1000]], "copy": true}',
]
n = 0
for f in fx:
    d = json.load(open(f))
    ids = [int(k) for k in d['elements']]
    for k in ids:
        for op in ops:
            print('FILE %s\n%s\ninspect {}\n---' % (f, op % json.dumps([k])), file=out)
            n += 1
    # groups of elements
    for _ in range(6):
        sel = random.sample(ids, min(len(ids), random.randint(2, 6)))
        for op in ops:
            print('FILE %s\n%s\n---' % (f, op % json.dumps(sel)), file=out)
            n += 1
print(n)

os.makedirs(D, exist_ok=True)
out = []


def mk(name, fn):
    f = F('IFC4', 'mm')
    f.header()
    s1 = f.storey('L1', 0.0)
    s2 = f.storey('L2', 3000.0)
    f.close_storeys()
    fn(f, s1, s2)
    out.append(f.save(os.path.join(D, name + '.ifc')))


def thick(f, s1, s2):
    prof = f.arb([(0, 0), (6000, 0), (6000, 4000), (0, 4000)])
    sl = f.add('IFCSLAB', gid(), None, 'Floor', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 0, -123.4567)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(prof, 123.4567)])), None, E('FLOOR'))
    f.contain(s1, sl)
    ce = f.add('IFCCOVERING', gid(), None, 'Ceiling', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 0, 2600)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(prof, 23.4567)])), None, E('CEILING'))
    f.contain(s1, ce)
    wall_rect(f, s1, 0, 10000, 5000, 10000, 123.4567, 3000.4567)
    lp = f.lp(s1.lp, (0, 20000, 0))
    w2 = f.add('IFCWALL', gid(), None, 'W2', None, None, lp, f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(5000, 200, (2500, 0)), 2999.12345)])), None, E('STANDARD'))
    f.contain(s1, w2)
    co = f.add('IFCCOLUMN', gid(), None, 'C', None, None, f.lp(s1.lp, (8000, 6000, 12.3456)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(300, 300), 2987.6543)])), None, E('COLUMN'))
    f.contain(s1, co)


mk('thick', thick)
print(' '.join(out))

"""More sequences that might be sets (sorted, deduplicated) in the original."""
import sys, json, copy
from multiprocessing import Pool
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/loader-agent')
from lib import *
d = load('/tmp/loader-agent/corpus/c8.bimcraft')
E = d['elements']


def first(cat, cond=lambda e: True):
    return next(k for k, e in E.items() if e['category'] == cat and cond(e))


cases = []


def case(label, path, val):
    cases.append((label, path, val))


vf = next(iter(d['view_filters']))
case('view filter categories', ['view_filters', vf, 'categories'], ['wall', 'door', 'wall'])
case('view filter categories 2', ['view_filters', vf, 'categories'], ['window', 'door'])
ci = first('cadimport')
case('cad hidden', ['elements', ci, 'hidden'], ['B', 'A', 'B'])
roof = first('roof', lambda e: len(e.get('boundary', [])) >= 4)
case('roof gables', ['elements', roof, 'gables'], [2, 0, 2])
case('roof gables 2', ['elements', roof, 'gables'], [3, 1])
case('roof slopes', ['elements', roof, 'slopes'], [30, 20, 30, 20])
case('line weights model', ['line_weights', 'model'], list(reversed(d['line_weights']['model'])) if len(d['line_weights']['model']) > 1 else d['line_weights']['model'] + [dict(d['line_weights']['model'][0], scale=200.0)])
wt = next(iter(d['wire_types']))
case('wire sizes', ['wire_types', wt, 'sizes'], list(reversed(d['wire_types'][wt]['sizes'])))
st = first('stair')
case('stair landings', ['elements', st, 'landings'], [{"at": 2000.0}, {"at": 1000.0}, {"at": 1000.0}])
fl = first('floor')
case('floor openings', ['elements', fl, 'openings'], [[[1000, 1000], [2000, 1000], [2000, 2000]], [[500, 500], [800, 500], [800, 800]]])
nt = first('text', lambda e: e.get('runs'))
case('note runs', ['elements', nt, 'runs'], list(reversed(E[nt]['runs'])) + [E[nt]['runs'][0]] if E[nt].get('runs') else [])
sch = first('schedule', lambda e: e.get('filters'))
case('schedule filters', ['elements', sch, 'filters'], E[sch]['filters'] + [E[sch]['filters'][0]])
case('schedule sort', ['elements', sch, 'sort'], [{"field": "Type"}, {"field": "Length"}, {"field": "Type"}])
case('schedule categories', ['elements', sch, 'categories'], ['wall', 'door', 'wall'])
fam = 'Ceiling Luminaire'
case('family connectors', ['families', fam, 'connectors'], list(reversed(d['families'][fam]['connectors'])) * 1)
lvl = first('level')
case('graphics layers', ['elements', lvl, 'graphics', 'layers'], {"k": ["b", "a", "b"]})
tpl = next(iter(d['view_templates']))
case('template controls', ['view_templates', tpl, 'controls'], ['style', 'categories', 'style', 'filters'])
case('phases', ['phases'], ['B', 'A', 'B'])
os_ = next(iter(d['option_sets']))
case('option set options', ['option_sets', os_, 'options'], d['option_sets'][os_]['options'] + [d['option_sets'][os_]['options'][0]])
dim = first('dimension', lambda e: len(e.get('refs', [])) >= 3)
case('dimension locked', ['elements', dim, 'locked'], [{"segment": 1, "length": 1000.0}, {"segment": 0, "length": 2000.0}])
case('dimension texts', ['elements', dim, 'texts'], [{"segment": 1, "prefix": "a"}, {"segment": 0, "prefix": "b"}])
pp = next(iter(d['parameters']))
case('parameter categories', ['parameters', pp, 'categories'], ['wall', 'door', 'wall'])
rm = first('room')
case('room params', ['elements', rm, 'params'], {"b": 1, "a": 2})


def getp(v, p):
    for k in p:
        v = v[k]
    return v


def one(c):
    label, path, val = c
    res = []
    for exe in (ORIG, MINE):
        e = copy.deepcopy(d)
        x = getp(e, path[:-1])
        x[path[-1]] = val
        code, msg, s = open_file(e, exe=exe, save=True)
        if code:
            res.append('ERR ' + msg[:250])
        else:
            try:
                res.append(norm(json.dumps(getp(json.loads(s), path))))
            except Exception as ex:
                res.append('MISSING')
    return label, val, res


with Pool(8) as pool:
    for label, val, (o, m) in pool.map(one, cases):
        print('%s %-26s %s' % ('same' if o == m else 'DIFF', label, norm(json.dumps(val))[:150]))
        print('     O:', o[:300])
        if o != m:
            print('     M:', m[:300])

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/ifc-import-agent')
from ifcgen import *
import os

D = '/tmp/ifc-import-agent/components/c31'
os.makedirs(D, exist_ok=True)
out = []


def model(X, Y):
    def fn(f):
        s1 = f.storey('L1', 0.0)
        s2 = f.storey('L2', 3000.0)
        f.close_storeys()
        P = lambda x=0, y=0, z=0: f.lp(s1.lp, (X + x, Y + y, z))
        w1 = wall_rect(f, s1, X, Y, X + 6000, Y, 200, 3000, name='W1')
        wall_rect(f, s1, X + 6000, Y, X + 6000, Y + 4000, 200, 3000, name='W2')
        # floor with a hole and a shaft
        prof = f.arb([(0, 0), (6000, 0), (6000, 4000), (0, 4000)], [[(1000, 1000), (2000, 1000), (2000, 2000), (1000, 2000)]])
        sl = f.add('IFCSLAB', gid(), None, 'Floor', None, None, P(0, 0, -200), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(prof, 200)])), None, E('FLOOR'))
        f.contain(s1, sl)
        op = f.add('IFCOPENINGELEMENT', gid(), None, 'Shaft', None, None, P(0, 0, -200), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(4000, 1000), (5000, 1000), (5000, 2000), (4000, 2000)]), 200)])), None, E('OPENING'))
        f.add('IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT', gid(), None, None, None, sl, op)
        # ceiling with a hole
        cprof = f.arb([(0, 0), (6000, 0), (6000, 4000), (0, 4000)], [[(3000, 1000), (3500, 1000), (3500, 1500), (3000, 1500)]])
        ce = f.add('IFCCOVERING', gid(), None, 'Ceiling', None, None, P(0, 0, 2600), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(cprof, 20)])), None, E('CEILING'))
        f.contain(s1, ce)
        # a flat roof with an opening (a profile with a void)
        rf = f.add('IFCROOF', gid(), None, 'Roof', None, None, f.lp(s2.lp, (X, Y, 0)), None, None, E('FLAT_ROOF'))
        f.contain(s2, rf)
        rprof = f.arb([(0, 0), (6000, 0), (6000, 4000), (0, 4000)], [[(500, 500), (1500, 500), (1500, 1500), (500, 1500)]])
        rs = f.add('IFCSLAB', gid(), None, 'Roof slab', None, None, f.lp(s2.lp, (X, Y, 0)), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(rprof, 300)])), None, E('ROOF'))
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, rf, (rs,))
        # a lofted mass
        mp = [(10000, 0, 0), (12000, 0, 0), (12000, 2000, 0), (10000, 2000, 0), (10500, 500, 3000), (11500, 500, 3000), (11500, 1500, 3000), (10500, 1500, 3000)]
        faces = [(0, 3, 2, 1), (4, 5, 6, 7), (0, 1, 5, 4), (1, 2, 6, 5), (2, 3, 7, 6), (3, 0, 4, 7)]
        ms = f.add('IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY', gid(), None, 'Mass', None, 'Mass', P(), f.pds(f.shape([f.brep(mp, faces)], 'Brep')), None, E('USERDEFINED'))
        f.contain(s1, ms)
        f.pset([ms], 'BIMCraft_Mass', {'Loft': 'IFCBOOLEAN(.T.)'})
        # a component, a beam, a column
        fu = f.add('IFCFURNITURE', gid(), None, 'Table:T', None, None, P(3000, 3000, 0), f.pds(f.shape([f.mesh_box(-400, -400, 0, 400, 400, 750)], 'Tessellation')), None, E('NOTDEFINED'))
        f.contain(s1, fu)
        bm = f.add('IFCBEAM', gid(), None, 'B', None, None, P(0, 6000, 2700), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(200, 300), 5000, pos=f.ax3((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0)))])), None, E('BEAM'))
        f.contain(s1, bm)
        co = f.add('IFCCOLUMN', gid(), None, 'C', None, None, P(8000, 6000, 0), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(300, 300), 3000)])), None, E('COLUMN'))
        f.contain(s1, co)
        # a room
        sp = f.add('IFCSPACE', gid(), None, '1', None, None, P(), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.arb([(0, 0), (6000, 0), (6000, 4000), (0, 4000)]), 2600)])), 'Office', E('ELEMENT'), E('SPACE'), None)
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, s1, (sp,))
        # a railing along an axis
        ax = f.shape([f.poly3([(0, 0, 1000), (3000, 0, 1000), (3000, 2000, 1000)])], 'Curve3D', 'Axis')
        bd = f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(50, 50, (0, 0)), 1000)])
        ra = f.add('IFCRAILING', gid(), None, 'R', None, None, P(14000, 0, 0), f.pds(ax, bd), None, E('GUARDRAIL'))
        f.contain(s1, ra)
        # a stair
        st = f.add('IFCSTAIR', gid(), None, 'Stair', None, None, P(16000, 0, 0), None, None, E('STRAIGHT_RUN_STAIR'))
        f.contain(s1, st)
        items = [f.extrude(f.rect(280, 900, (140 + i * 280, 0)), 175 * (i + 1)) for i in range(3)]
        fl = f.add('IFCSTAIRFLIGHT', gid(), None, 'Flight', None, None, P(16000, 0, 0), f.pds(f.shape(items)), None, 4, 3, 175.0, 280.0, E('STRAIGHT'))
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, st, (fl,))
        # rebar in the beam
        rb = f.add('IFCREINFORCINGBAR', gid(), None, 'Bar', None, None, P(0, 6000, 2700), f.pds(f.shape([f.add('IFCSWEPTDISKSOLID', f.poly3([(50, 0, -100), (4950, 0, -100)]), 8.0, None, None, None)], 'AdvancedSweptSolid')), None, 'CA-50', 16.0, None, None, E('MAIN'), None)
        f.add('IFCRELAGGREGATES', gid(), None, None, None, bm, (rb,))
        # a grid placed far
        a1 = f.add('IFCGRIDAXIS', 'A', f.poly2([(0, -1000), (0, 5000)], close=False), True)
        a2 = f.add('IFCGRIDAXIS', '1', f.poly2([(-1000, 0), (7000, 0)], close=False), True)
        g = f.add('IFCGRID', gid(), None, 'Grid', None, None, P(), None, (a1,), (a2,), None, E('RECTANGULAR'))
        f.contain(s1, g)
        # a door in W1
        o = f.add('IFCOPENINGELEMENT', gid(), None, 'O', None, None, P(1000, 0, 0), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(900, 400, (450, 0)), 2100)])), None, E('OPENING'))
        f.add('IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT', gid(), None, None, None, w1, o)
        d = f.add('IFCDOOR', gid(), None, 'D', None, None, P(1000, 0, 0), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.rect(900, 50, (450, 0)), 2100)])), None, 2100.0, 900.0, E('DOOR'), E('SINGLE_SWING_LEFT'), None)
        f.add('IFCRELFILLSELEMENT', gid(), None, None, None, o, d)
        f.contain(s1, d)
        # a room separation line
        vs = f.add('IFCVIRTUALELEMENT', gid(), None, 'Sep', None, 'RoomSeparation', P(), f.pds(f.shape([f.poly3([(3000, 0), (3000, 4000)])], 'Curve3D', 'Axis')), None)
        f.contain(s1, vs)
        # a pipe and a sloped floor
        pp = f.add('IFCPIPESEGMENT', gid(), None, 'P', None, None, P(0, 8000, 500), f.pds(f.shape([f.extrude(f.add('IFCCIRCLEPROFILEDEF', E('AREA'), None, f.ax2(), 50.0), 3000, pos=f.ax3((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0)))])), None, E('RIGIDSEGMENT'))
        f.contain(s1, pp)
        sp_ = [(20000, 0, 0), (24000, 0, 400), (24000, 3000, 400), (20000, 3000, 0), (20000, 0, -200), (24000, 0, 200), (24000, 3000, 200), (20000, 3000, -200)]
        faces = [(0, 1, 2, 3), (4, 7, 6, 5), (0, 4, 5, 1), (1, 5, 6, 2), (2, 6, 7, 3), (3, 7, 4, 0)]
        sf = f.add('IFCSLAB', gid(), None, 'Sloped', None, None, P(), f.pds(f.shape([f.brep(sp_, faces)], 'Brep')), None, E('FLOOR'))
        f.contain(s1, sf)
        # a ramp
        prof = f.arb([(0, 0), (3000, 300), (3000, 400), (0, 100)])
        solid = f.extrude(prof, 1200, pos=f.ax3((0, 600, 0), (0, -1, 0), (1, 0, 0)))
        rp2 = f.add('IFCRAMP', gid(), None, 'RampBody', None, None, P(0, 12000, 0), f.pds(f.shape([solid])), None, E('STRAIGHT_RUN_RAMP'))
        f.contain(s1, rp2)
    return fn


for name, X, Y in [('near', 0, 0), ('far', 250000000, 150000000)]:
    f = F('IFC4', 'mm')
    f.header()
    model(X, Y)(f)
    out.append(f.save(os.path.join(D, name + '.ifc')))
print(' '.join(out))

"""Where the original checks a view template's phase, against other faults."""
import sys, json, copy
from multiprocessing import Pool
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/loader-agent')
from lib import *
d = load('/tmp/loader-agent/corpus/c8.bimcraft')
E = d['elements']
lib = d['library']


def libkey(kind, name):
    return next(k for k, v in lib.items() if v['kind'] == kind and v['name'] == name)


tpl = 'Sec T'
print('template graphics:', json.dumps(d['view_templates'][tpl].get('graphics'))[:300])


def faults():
    F = {}

    def tpl_phase(e):
        e['view_templates'][tpl].setdefault('graphics', {})['phase'] = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa'
    F['tpl_phase_guid'] = tpl_phase

    def tpl_phase_name(e):
        e['view_templates'][tpl].setdefault('graphics', {})['phase'] = 'Nope'
    F['tpl_phase_name'] = tpl_phase_name

    def dup_phases(e):
        e['phases'] = ['Existing', 'New Construction', 'Existing']
    F['dup_phases'] = dup_phases

    def line_style(e):
        k = next(iter(e['line_styles']))
        e['line_styles'][k]['pattern'] = 'Nope'
    F['line_style_pattern'] = line_style

    def text_type(e):
        k = next(iter(e['text_types']))
        e['text_types'][k]['size'] = -1
    F['text_type_size'] = text_type

    def dup_option(e):
        k = next(iter(e['option_sets']))
        e['option_sets'][k]['options'].append(e['option_sets'][k]['options'][0])
    F['dup_option'] = dup_option

    def wall_type(e):
        e['types']['wall']['Exterior - 300mm']['thickness'] = 999
    F['wall_type_thickness'] = wall_type

    def fam(e):
        e['families']['Box']['types']['Big']['Width'] = 'zz'
    F['family_value'] = fam

    def mat(e):
        k = next(iter(e['materials']))
        e['materials'][k]['cut_pattern'] = 'Nope'
    F['material_pattern'] = mat

    def lvl_phase(e):
        lv = next(k for k, x in e['elements'].items() if x['category'] == 'level')
        e['elements'][lv].setdefault('graphics', {})['phase'] = 'Nope'
    F['level_phase'] = lvl_phase

    def vf(e):
        k = next(iter(e['view_filters']))
        e['view_filters'][k]['categories'] = ['zz']
    F['view_filter_cat'] = vf

    def pf(e):
        k = next(iter(e['phase_filters']))
        e['phase_filters'] = dict(e.get('phase_filters', {}))
        e['phase_filters']['Bad:Name'] = {"new": "by-category"}
    F['phase_filter_name'] = pf

    def tpl_filter(e):
        e['view_templates'][tpl].setdefault('graphics', {})['phase_filter'] = 'Nope'
    F['tpl_phase_filter'] = tpl_filter

    def tpl_template_pattern(e):
        e['view_templates'][tpl].setdefault('graphics', {}).setdefault('categories', {})['wall'] = {"cut": {"foreground": {"pattern": "Nope"}}}
    F['tpl_fill_pattern'] = tpl_template_pattern
    return F


F = faults()
pairs = [('tpl_phase_guid', x) for x in F if x not in ('tpl_phase_guid', 'tpl_phase_name')] + \
        [('tpl_phase_name', x) for x in F if x not in ('tpl_phase_guid', 'tpl_phase_name')] + \
        [(x, None) for x in F]


def one(pair):
    a, b = pair
    res = []
    for exe in (ORIG, MINE):
        e = copy.deepcopy(d)
        F[a](e)
        if b:
            F[b](e)
        code, msg, s = open_file(e, exe=exe, save=False)
        res.append(msg.replace('open: x.bimcraft: ', '')[:200] if code else 'OK')
    return pair, res


with Pool(8) as pool:
    for (a, b), (o, m) in pool.map(one, pairs):
        print('%s %-16s + %-20s O: %s' % ('same' if o == m else 'DIFF', a, b, o))
        if o != m:
            print('%43s M: %s' % ('', m))

"""The order of the checks of a view's or a template's graphics: pairs of faults."""
import sys, json, copy, itertools
from multiprocessing import Pool
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/loader-agent')
from lib import *
d = load('/tmp/loader-agent/corpus/c8.bimcraft')
E = d['elements']
LV = next(k for k, x in E.items() if x['category'] == 'level')
WALL = next(x['guid'] for k, x in E.items() if x['category'] == 'wall')
target = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'template'


def gr(e):
    if target == 'template':
        return e['view_templates']['Sec T'].setdefault('graphics', {})
    return e['elements'][LV].setdefault('graphics', {})


F = {
    'phase': lambda g: g.__setitem__('phase', 'NopePhase'),
    'phase_filter': lambda g: g.__setitem__('phase_filter', 'NopeFilter'),
    'option_set': lambda g: g.setdefault('options', {}).__setitem__('NopeSet', None),
    'view_filter': lambda g: g.setdefault('filters', []).append({'filter': 'NopeVF'}),
    'cat_pattern': lambda g: g.setdefault('categories', {}).__setitem__('wall', {'cut': {'foreground': {'pattern': 'NopePat'}}}),
    'filter_pattern': lambda g: g.setdefault('filters', []).insert(0, {'filter': next(iter(d['view_filters'])), 'cut': {'foreground': {'pattern': 'NopePat2'}}}),
    'cat_key': lambda g: g.setdefault('categories', {}).__setitem__('zzcat', {'hidden': True}),
    'template': lambda g: g.__setitem__('template', 'NopeTpl'),
    'element_key': lambda g: g.setdefault('elements', {}).__setitem__('00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa', {'hidden': True}),
    'element_pattern': lambda g: g.setdefault('elements', {}).__setitem__(WALL, {'cut': {'foreground': {'pattern': 'NopePat3'}}}),
    'linework_style': lambda g: g.setdefault('linework', []).append({'element': WALL, 'from': [0, 0], 'to': [0, 100], 'style': 'NopeLS'}),
    'scale': lambda g: g.__setitem__('scale', 0.5),
    'transparency': lambda g: g.setdefault('categories', {}).__setitem__('floor', {'transparency': 150}),
}
names = list(F)
jobs = [(a, None) for a in names] + list(itertools.combinations(names, 2))


def one(job):
    a, b = job
    res = []
    for exe in (ORIG, MINE):
        e = copy.deepcopy(d)
        g = gr(e)
        F[a](g)
        if b:
            F[b](g)
        code, msg, s = open_file(e, exe=exe, save=False)
        res.append(msg.replace('open: x.bimcraft: ', '')[:200] if code else 'OK')
    return job, res


with Pool(8) as pool:
    for (a, b), (o, m) in pool.map(one, jobs):
        print('%s %-16s + %-16s O: %s' % ('same' if o == m else 'DIFF', a, b, o))
        if o != m:
            print('%39s M: %s' % ('', m))

import math
exec(open('/tmp/views-lines/an49.py').read().split('res = []')[0])
def D(p, f, sq=True):
    c = C(f); x, y = c[0]-p[0], c[1]-p[1]
    return x*x+y*y if sq else math.sqrt(x*x+y*y)
def newton(p, f, h, iters, sq, form):
    for _ in range(iters):
        if form == 'd2':
            g = (D(p, f+h, sq) - D(p, f-h, sq))/(2*h)
            gg = (D(p, f+h, sq) - 2*D(p, f, sq) + D(p, f-h, sq))/(h*h)
        else:
            # derivative of the curve by central differences; Gauss-Newton on (C-p).C'
            a, b = C(f-h), C(f+h)
            t = ((b[0]-a[0])/(2*h), (b[1]-a[1])/(2*h))
            c = C(f)
            g = (c[0]-p[0])*t[0] + (c[1]-p[1])*t[1]
            gg = t[0]*t[0] + t[1]*t[1]
        if gg <= 0: break
        nf = f - g/gg
        if nf == f: break
        f = nf
    return f
best = []
for form in ['d2', 'gn']:
    for sq in [True, False]:
        for h in [1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-6, 1e-7, 1e-8, 1e-9]:
            for iters in [1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 50]:
                errs = []
                for p, q in targets:
                    fo = math.atan2(q[1], q[0])/(2*math.pi)
                    ang = math.atan2(p[1], p[0])
                    # chord-based start
                    kseg = int(ang/(2*math.pi)*N)
                    Pa, Pb = C(kseg/N), C((kseg+1)/N)
                    dx, dy = Pb[0]-Pa[0], Pb[1]-Pa[1]
                    s = ((p[0]-Pa[0])*dx + (p[1]-Pa[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy)
                    f0 = kseg/N + s*((kseg+1)/N - kseg/N)
                    f = newton(p, f0, h, iters, sq, form)
                    errs.append(abs(f - fo))
                best.append((max(errs), form, sq, h, iters))
best.sort()
for b in best[:10]: print(b)

"""The asset IFC files, their site (or building) placed 250 km east and 150 km north."""
import glob
import os
import re

D = '/tmp/ifc-import-agent/components/c32'
os.makedirs(D, exist_ok=True)
out = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/assets/**/*.ifc', recursive=True)):
    text = open(f, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
    lines = text.split('\n')
    ents = {}
    for l in lines:
        m = re.match(r'#(\d+)=([A-Z0-9]+)\((.*)\);\s*$', l)
        if m:
            ents[int(m.group(1))] = (m.group(2), m.group(3))
    # the site's placement → its axis placement → its point
    site = [k for k, v in ents.items() if v[0] == 'IFCSITE']
    if not site:
        continue
    args = ents[site[0]][1]
    refs = re.findall(r'#(\d+)', args)
    lp = None
    for r in refs:
        if ents.get(int(r), ('',))[0] == 'IFCLOCALPLACEMENT':
            lp = int(r)
            break
    if lp is None:
        continue
    ax = int(re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[lp][1])[-1])
    pt = int(re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[ax][1])[0])
    # the point may be shared: write a new one
    unit_m = 'METRE.)' in text and '.MILLI.' not in text
    X, Y = (250000.0, 150000.0) if unit_m else (250000000.0, 150000000.0)
    new_id = max(ents) + 1
    new_line = '#%d=IFCCARTESIANPOINT((%r,%r,0.));' % (new_id, X, Y)
    new_lines = []
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith('#%d=' % ax):
            l = l.replace('#%d' % pt, '#%d' % new_id, 1) if False else re.sub(r'\(#%d,' % pt, '(#%d,' % new_id, l, count=1)
        new_lines.append(l)
        if l.startswith('DATA;'):
            new_lines.append(new_line)
    name = f.replace('/workspace/assets/', '').replace('/', '__')
    p = os.path.join(D, name)
    open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(new_lines))
    out.append(p)
print(' '.join(out))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""chk2.py base.bimcraft cases.txt: like chk.py but saves after `grid` and prints the modified line as saved."""
import json, sys, subprocess, tempfile, shutil, os
base = sys.argv[1]
for l in open(sys.argv[2]):
    l = l.strip()
    if not l or l.startswith('#'): continue
    eid, upd = l.split(' ', 1)
    upd = json.loads(upd)
    d = json.load(open(base))
    e = d['elements'][eid]
    for k, v in upd.items():
        if v is None: e.pop(k, None)
        else: e[k] = v
    t = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='c', dir='/tmp/views-lines/scratch')
    open(os.path.join(t, 'in.bimcraft'), 'w').write(json.dumps(d, indent=2))
    p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', 'in.bimcraft', '--cmd', 'grid {"start":[0,0],"end":[0,5000]}', '--save', 'o.bimcraft'], cwd=t, capture_output=True)
    print('>>', l)
    if p.returncode == 0:
        o = json.load(open(os.path.join(t, 'o.bimcraft')))['elements'][eid]
        print('  ', json.dumps(o))
    else:
        print('  ', p.stderr.decode().strip())
    shutil.rmtree(t)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sloped floors whose arrow's tail is on an edge at x: the sign of the top's height at the
tail's corners, for several x."""
import json, re, subprocess, os
xs = [int(v) for v in os.environ.get("XS", "0 512 1000 2000 4000 8000 10000 16000 20000 30000 100000").split()]
L = float(os.environ.get("LEN", "4000"))
ang = float(os.environ.get("SLOPE", "5"))
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
cmds = []
for k, x in enumerate(xs):
    y = 10000 * k
    cmds.append('floor ' + json.dumps({"boundary": [[x, y], [x + L, y], [x + L, y + 4000], [x, y + 4000]], "slope": ang,
                                       "arrow": [[x, y + 2000], [x + L, y + 2000]]}))
open(D + '/slsign.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/slsign.txt', '--save', D + '/slsign.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
s = open(D + '/slsign.ifc').read()
for k, x in enumerate(xs):
    y = 10000 * k
    m = re.findall(r"IFCCARTESIANPOINT\(\((%s\.,%s\.,[^)]*)\)\)" % (x, y), s)
    print(x, m)

    'edge -1e9 to': {'linework': [{'element': WALL, 'from': [0, 0], 'to': [0, -1.0000001e9]}]},
}


def one(item):
    label, g0 = item
    res = []
    for exe in (ORIG, MINE):
        e = copy.deepcopy(d)
        g = gr(e)
        for k, v in g0.items():
            g[k] = copy.deepcopy(v)
        code, msg, s = open_file(e, exe=exe, save=False)
        res.append(msg.replace('open: x.bimcraft: ', '')[:220] if code else 'OK')

with Pool(8) as pool:
    for label, (o, m) in pool.map(one, cases.items()):
        print('%s %-36s O: %s' % ('same' if o == m else 'DIFF', label, o))
        if o != m:

import pickle, sys, math, struct
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rebar-agent')
import beam_lib as B
data = pickle.load(open('/tmp/rebar-agent/search_beam.cache', 'rb'))
def nudge(x, k):
    b = struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]
    return struct.unpack('<d', struct.pack('<q', b + k))[0]
def score(e, elev, t, bars, half, z0mode=1):
    w, h = t['width'], t['depth']; s, en = e['start'], e['end']
    off = e.get('offset', 0.0); eoff = e.get('end_offset', off); just = e.get('justify', 'top')
    dx = en[0]-s[0]; dy = en[1]-s[1]
    sg = -1.0 if just == 'top' else 1.0
    z0 = (elev+off) + sg*half; z1 = (elev+eoff) + sg*half
    dv = [dx, dy, z1 - z0]
    L = B.length(dv); al = B.normalize(dv); ac = B.normalize([-al[1], al[0], 0.0]); up = B.cross(al, ac)
    F = dict(o=[s[0], s[1], z0 - elev], al=al, ac=ac, up=up)
    c = 30.0; hh = h/2; hw = w/2
    exp = []
    for name, d, n in (('b', 12.5, 3), ('t', 6.3, 2)):
        a = hw - c - d/2
        ats = [-a + (2*a)*i/(n-1) for i in range(n)]
        u = -(hh - c - d/2) if name == 'b' else hh - c - d/2
        for aa in ats:
            exp.append([B.at(F, c, aa, u), B.at(F, L - c, aa, u)])
    ok = tot = 0
    for bb, ex in zip(bars, exp):
        for p1, p2 in zip(bb, ex):
            for x, y in zip(p1, p2):
                tot += 1; ok += x == y
    return ok, tot
for key, (e, elev, t, bars) in data.items():
    off = e.get('offset', 0.0); eoff = e.get('end_offset', off); just = e.get('justify', 'top')
    if off == eoff or just == 'centre': continue
    w, h = t['width'], t['depth']; s, en = e['start'], e['end']
    dx = en[0]-s[0]; dy = en[1]-s[1]
    plan = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); rz = eoff-off; ln = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+rz*rz)
    ha = h/2.0*(ln/plan)
    good = []
    for k in range(-40, 41):
        hv = nudge(ha, k)
        ok, tot = score(e, elev, t, bars, hv)
        if ok == tot: good.append(k)
    print(key, 'half_a', repr(ha), 'good ulp offsets', good)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bisect the horizontal drain's ok boundary (flow vs carries) for several pipes, on serde-exact floats."""
import sys, json, struct, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/hydro-agent')
from lib import *

def bits(x):
    return struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]

def fl(b):
    return struct.unpack('<d', struct.pack('<q', b))[0]

m = MCP(ORIG)

def ok(q, d, s):
    t = canon(*m.calls([('storm_size', RawJ('{"kind":"horizontal","flow":%r,"slope":%r,"inside":%r}' % (q, s, d)))])[0])
    return json.loads(t[3:])['ok']

out = []
r = random.Random(4)
cases = [(100, 0.01), (50, 0.005), (150, 0.02), (75, 0.01), (200, 0.005), (1000, 1.0), (10000, 0.5), (33.3, 0.0123),
         (88.8, 0.007), (125, 0.015)]
for _ in range(30):
    cases.append((round(r.uniform(20, 3000), 1), round(r.uniform(0.005, 0.2), 4)))
for d, s in cases:
    # find a bracket by doubling
    lo, hi = 1e-6, 1e9
    while not ok(lo, d, s):
        lo /= 10
    while ok(hi, d, s):
        hi *= 10
    a, b = bits(lo), bits(hi)
    while b - a > 1:
        mid = (a + b) // 2
        # only ask about floats whose repr parses back exactly (repr is 17 digits at most; serde may differ)
        x = fl(mid)
        if ok(x, d, s):
            a = mid
        else:
            b = mid
    out.append((d, s, repr(fl(a)), repr(fl(b))))
    print(d, s, repr(fl(a)), repr(fl(b)))
json.dump(out, open('/tmp/hydro-agent/manb.json', 'w'))
m.close()

import sys, json, subprocess, os, concurrent.futures, re
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rebar-agent')
MINE = '/workspace/.claude/worktrees/agent-add01394c801ae7f2/target/release/bimcraft-cli'
cases = []
for fn in sys.argv[1:]:
    cur = None
    for line in open(fn):
        line = line.rstrip('\n')
        if not line.strip() or line.startswith('#'): continue
        if line.startswith('@file'):
            cur = line.split(None, 1)[1].strip(); continue
        cases.append((cur, line))
def run(c):
    f, line = c
    cl = ['python3', '/tmp/tools/cmp.py', '-f', f, '--', 'run', os.path.basename(f)]
    for x in line.split(' ;; '): cl += ['--cmd', x]
    cl += ['--save', 'out.bimcraft']
    env = dict(os.environ); env['MINE'] = MINE
    p = subprocess.run(cl, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    return c, p.stdout.strip().endswith('SAME'), p.stdout
stats = {}
fails = []
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(8) as ex:
    for (f, line), ok, out in ex.map(run, cases):
        j = json.load(open(f))
        p = json.loads(line.split(' ', 1)[1])
        e = j['elements'].get(str(p.get('host')), {})
        off = e.get('offset', 0.0); eoff = e.get('end_offset', off)
        kind = '%s-%s-%s' % (e.get('category'), 'sloped' if off != eoff else 'flat', e.get('justify', '-'))
        s = stats.setdefault(kind, [0, 0]); s[1] += 1
        if ok: s[0] += 1
        else: fails.append((kind, f, line, out))
for k, v in sorted(stats.items()): print(k, '%d/%d' % tuple(v))
json.dump(fails, open('/tmp/rebar-agent/fails.json', 'w'))

import sys, json, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/hydro-agent')
from lib import serde_f64
data=json.load(open('/tmp/hydro-agent/manb.json'))
th=2*math.acos(1-2*(2/3))
for d,s,lo,hi in data:
    D=d/1000
    A=D*D/8*(th-math.sin(th)); P=th*D/2; R=A/P
    c=A*R**(2/3)*math.sqrt(s)/0.011*60000
    lo=serde_f64(lo); hi=serde_f64(hi)
    # find the c values (by ulp shift) for which lo<=c+1e-9<hi
    ok=[]
    for k in range(-6,7):
        cc=c+k*math.ulp(c)
        if lo<=cc+1e-9 and not hi<=cc+1e-9: ok.append(k)
    print('%8.1f %7.4f shift ok: %s' % (d,s,ok))
"

import json, sys, math, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/rebar-agent')
import beam_lib as B, fit_beam3 as fb
f, bid, params = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], json.loads(sys.argv[3])
j0 = json.load(open('/tmp/rebar-agent/' + f)); e = j0['elements'][bid]
elev = [v for v in j0['elements'].values() if v['guid'] == e['level']][0]['elevation']
tname = [v['name'] for v in j0['library'].values() if v['guid'] == e['type']][0]; t = j0['types']['runs']['beam'][tname]
F = B.frame(e, elev, t)
p = dict(params); p['host'] = int(bid)
j = fb.run_orig('/tmp/rebar-agent/' + f, 'reinforce ' + json.dumps(p))
st = [v['path'] for v in j['elements'].values() if v['category'] == 'rebar' and v.get('layer') == 'stirrup']
cv = params['cover']; cs = cv if not isinstance(cv, dict) else cv['sides']
ct = cv if not isinstance(cv, dict) else cv['top']
ds = params['stirrup']['diameter']; sp = params['stirrup']['spacing']
h = t['depth']; w = t['width']; hh = h/2; hw = w/2
a_in = hw - cs - ds; top_in = hh - ct - ds
sa = a_in + ds/2; su = top_in + ds/2
L = F['L']
o, al, ac, up = F['o'], F['al'], F['ac'], F['up']
s0 = cs + ds/2; s1 = L - (cs + ds/2)
n = math.ceil((s1 - s0) / sp)
# solve for the t the original used at each station from x (and y): t = (x - (o_x + ac_x*a + up_x*u)) / al_x approx
forms = {
    'mul': lambda i: s0 + (s1 - s0) * i / n,
    'mul2': lambda i: s0 + (s1 - s0) * (i / n),
    'step': lambda i: s0 + ((s1 - s0) / n) * i,
    'lerp': lambda i: s0 + (s1 - s0) * i / n if i < n else s1,
    'rev': lambda i: s1 - (s1 - s0) * (n - i) / n,
    'sym': lambda i: s0 + (s1 - s0) * i / n if 2 * i <= n else s1 - (s1 - s0) * (n - i) / n,
}
for fn, ff in forms.items():
    bad = []
    for i, path in enumerate(st):
        q = B.at(F, ff(i), -sa, su)
        if any(x != y for x, y in zip(q, path[0])): bad.append(i)
    print(fn, len(bad), bad[:30])

import beam_lib as B
f, bid = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
want = float(sys.argv[3]); ct = float(sys.argv[4]); ds = float(sys.argv[5]); cb = float(sys.argv[6])
j0 = json.load(open('/tmp/rebar-agent/' + f)); e = j0['elements'][bid]
elev = [v for v in j0['elements'].values() if v['guid'] == e['level']][0]['elevation']
tname = [v['name'] for v in j0['library'].values() if v['guid'] == e['type']][0]; t = j0['types']['runs']['beam'][tname]
h = t['depth']; hh = h / 2
F = B.frame(e, elev, t)
o = F['o'][2]; upz = F['up'][2]
cands = {
    'k': (hh - ct - ds) + ds / 2,
    'a': hh - ct - ds / 2,
    'b': hh - (ct + ds / 2),
    'frombot': -hh + (h - ct - ds / 2),
    'frombot2': (-hh) + (h - (ct + ds / 2)),
    'frombot3': -hh + h - ct - ds / 2,
    'inner': ((h - ct - cb - 2 * ds) / 2 + ds / 2),
}
for k, u in cands.items():
    z = o + upz * u
    print(k, repr(u), repr(z), z == want)

"""Linked CAD drawings on opening: which paths the original reads, what it says, what it keeps."""
import sys, json, copy, zlib, base64
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/loader-agent')
from lib import *
d = load('/tmp/loader-agent/corpus/c8.bimcraft')
DXF = open('/tmp/loader-agent/corpus/plan.dxf', 'rb').read()
DXF2 = DXF.replace(b'Walls', b'Walls2')


def dxf_of(saved):
    c = json.loads(saved)['cads']['Plan DXF']
    raw = base64.b64decode(c['dxf'])
    try:
        return zlib.decompress(raw)[:60], {k: v for k, v in c.items() if k != 'dxf'}
    except Exception as e:
        return ('undecodable %r' % e), {k: v for k, v in c.items() if k != 'dxf'}


cases = [
    ('no ext', 'zz', {}),
    ('dwg', 'x.dwg', {}),
    ('DXF upper missing', 'x.DXF', {}),
    ('dxf missing', 'x.dxf', {}),
    ('dxf present same', 'plan.dxf', {'plan.dxf': DXF}),
    ('dxf present changed', 'plan.dxf', {'plan.dxf': DXF2}),
    ('DXF upper present', 'PLAN.DXF', {'PLAN.DXF': DXF2}),
    ('dxf garbage', 'plan.dxf', {'plan.dxf': b'garbage'}),
    ('dxf empty', 'plan.dxf', {'plan.dxf': b''}),
    ('dxf in subdir', 'sub/plan.dxf', {'sub/plan.dxf': DXF2}),
    ('dir as path', 'sub', {'sub/a.txt': b'x'}),
    ('dir with dxf ext', 'sub.dxf', {'sub.dxf/a.txt': b'x'}),
    ('pdf', 'x.pdf', {}),
    ('trailing dot', 'x.', {}),
    ('dot file', '.dxf', {}),
    ('absolute missing', '/nonexistent/x.dxf', {}),
    ('ifc', 'x.ifc', {}),
    ('svg', 'x.svg', {}),
    ('png', 'x.png', {}),
]
for label, path, files in cases:
    out = []
    for exe in (ORIG, MINE):
        e = copy.deepcopy(d)
        e['cads']['Plan DXF']['path'] = path
        fl = dict(files)
        fl['x.bimcraft'] = dumps(e)
        code, so, se, after = run(['run', 'x.bimcraft', '--save', 'y.bimcraft'], fl, exe=exe)
        if code:
            out.append('ERR ' + se.strip()[:200])
            continue
        reply = json.loads(so.splitlines()[0])
        cad = reply.get('cads_not_reloaded')
        dx = dxf_of(after['y.bimcraft'])
        out.append('%s | %s' % (json.dumps(cad), dx))
    print('%s %-20s O: %s' % ('same' if out[0] == out[1] else 'DIFF', label, out[0][:300]))
    if out[0] != out[1]:
        print('%25s M: %s' % ('', out[1][:300]))
